parameters.name: Direction
parameters.description:
The traffic direction of the IPv4 access control policy for the Internet firewall. Valid values:

- in: inbound traffic.

- out: outbound traffic.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the response message. Valid values:

- zh (default): Chinese.

- en: English.

parameters.name: NewOrder
parameters.description:
The new priority for the IPv4 access control policy of the Internet firewall. The priority is a number. A smaller number indicates a higher priority. The value 1 indicates the highest priority.

> The new priority value cannot be outside the range of existing priorities for IPv4 policies. Otherwise, the API call fails. Before you call this operation, call [DescribePolicyPriorUsed](~~138862~~) to query the priority range of IPv4 policies for a specific traffic direction.

parameters.name: OldOrder
parameters.description: The current priority of the IPv4 access control policy that you want to modify.

parameters.name: SourceIp
parameters.description: The source IP address of the visitor.
